checks: Inspect font loading and render-blocking resources.
Test menus, search, forms, and booking interactions.
Check dynamic content for layout shifts.
Monitor failed requests and browser errors.
Check critical journeys and external dependencies.
Verify graceful handling of service failures.

core_web_vitals_reference.evaluation_context: Use the applicable official measurement methodology, preferably field data at the 75th percentile where available. The ranges are reference thresholds, not a guarantee of user experience or ranking.

measurement_modes.field: Real-user measurements under actual device and network conditions.
measurement_modes.lab: Controlled tests useful for repeatable diagnosis and regression checks.
measurement_modes.synthetic: Scheduled tests from defined locations, devices, and network settings.

optimization_rules: Record device class, network conditions, region, page template, and test method where available.
Use both field and lab evidence when practical.
Prioritize issues by user impact, business importance, and implementation risk.
Re-test the same pages and conditions after optimization.
Do not remove accessibility, security, or essential workflow functionality to improve speed scores.
Do not report a lab result as a real-user field result.
